sections.changelog:
Added

  • **English-language search, on par with Russian.** Ready-made synonym dictionaries now ship for English stores too — electronics parts, auto parts and clothing/footwear, each with US/UK spelling variants (tyre/tire, trousers/pants, sneakers/trainers) — installable in one click from the Relevance tab. English morphology already worked out of the box; this fills the one gap that was Russian-only.

Changed

  • **Fuller English stop-word list.** Common English function words (pronouns, auxiliaries, prepositions, conjunctions) are no longer indexed, so they stop diluting relevance on English and mixed-language catalogs. Product- and brand-anchoring words (Pro, Air, Max, Off-White, New Balance, price words like "under/over") are deliberately kept. Reindex to apply to existing content.
